text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today is Doto-san's very first graded 
race! Please! I hope she runs without 
getting misled by my words!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—The result was 2nd place! Doto-san was 
overjoyed and even thanked me for the 
other day! Ugh, her sheer adoration for 
Opera O-san is blindingly dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“But that wasn't just 'fangirl squeals,' 
it was a fiery passion... The feelings 
those Umamusume pour into their races are 
so much more pure than that!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An unknown radiance drives me forward. To 
uncover the true nature of this light, I 
have no choice but to face it head-on in 
the upcoming Hyacinth Stakes...!
